keySentence: Real is what love gives you.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The boy understood. Love makes us real. The rabbit taught him. Real is what love gives you.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The boy looked into the rabbit's warm, familiar eyes. He remembered all the nights they spent together. Real is what love gives you when it is true and deep. The boy learned this lesson from his velveteen rabbit. Love had made the toy real and taught the boy about life. They both became real through the power of their love.
facts.Word cards: became = 됐다 / real = 진짜의 / jump = 뛰다 / now = 이제
